name: mail-acks-missing
description: A partner sent 12 orders and got no acknowledgements and asks for a check of the Orders production: a current failure that OcuTalon can look into with its read-only tools, so it acts.

item.subject: 12 orders sent, no acknowledgements
item.text: Hello, we sent 12 orders to your Orders production in the last hour and have received no acknowledgements. Please check the Orders production for errors. Thanks, Order Partner Operations
